source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: When victory is completed for you, O Messenger, over the disbelievers of Quraysh, and the conquest of Makkah is accomplished for you,
tafsir.muyassar-2: and you see many people entering Islam in crowds,
tafsir.muyassar-3: then prepare to meet your Lord by abundantly glorifying Him with praise and abundantly seeking His forgiveness. He is ever Accepting of repentance from those who glorify and seek forgiveness — He accepts their repentance and shows them mercy.
